description: Call a Cap on the user's behalf and return its response. Use this when you cannot make the HTTP call yourself: qumge charges the user's qumge balance and forwards the call at the same price as calling it over HTTP through Qumge. Operations and prices come from get_cap. Prefer `operation` + `input`: when the operation declares an input_schema, `input` is validated against it before anything is charged or forwarded. For managed results, pass a stable idempotency_key when retrying; asynchronous calls return a platform job_id and get_cap_job reads cached progress and the final receipt for free. Needs the user's qumge key in the Authorization header. A 5xx from the Cap is free; a 402 means the user's balance or this Cap's monthly limit stopped it. (Older clients may still call this tool as call_app — it still works.)

body.description: Request body. An object is sent as JSON; a string is sent as-is.

content_type.description: Only needed when `body` is a string and the app expects a specific type.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for retries of the same operation and input. Replays the original managed order; changed input is rejected.

input.description: Arguments for the operation. Validated against its input_schema when it has one — an invalid input is refused as a tool error (isError), and nothing is charged or forwarded.

method.description: HTTP method. Default GET — the routes and their methods are in get_cap.

operation.description: Operation name from get_cap (a route's `name`). Use with `input`; takes precedence over `path`/`method` when both are given.

path.description: The route path from get_cap, e.g. '/api/videos'. A query string may be appended or passed separately in `query`.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: call_cap

free_call.description: Set when this call used one of the operation's free calls (users who have topped up).

cancellation.description: Optional timeout notification status; acknowledgement does not prove that provider work stopped.

delivery.description: The provider's declared retention commitment and optional free result URL renewal support.

error_omitted.description: The provider error is omitted from this tool response; read job_url for the full cached document.

job_url.description: Free authenticated GET endpoint for the full cached job document.

result_omitted.description: The complete result is omitted from this tool response; read job_url for the full cached document.
